Your beast's Intelligence score is 6, and you assign its other ability scores using a standard array (16, 14, 12, 10, 8) as you see fit.

entries.name: Beast Features
entries: All beasts share the following traits.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d4 per beast companion level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 4 + your beast's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d4 (or 3) + your beast's Constitution modifier per beast level after 1st
{@b Languages:} Your beast can understand simple commands spoken in two languages of your choice, as well as hand signals, but it can not speak
{@b Size:} Tiny
{@b Speed:} 20 ft.
{@b Type:} Beast
{@b Armor Class:} Your beast's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier.
{@b Barding:} Your beast requires proficiency in armor in order to have it made into barding for them, and if the your beast's size increases, the barding must be upgraded accordingly.
{@b Natural Weapon:} Your beast companion attacks with a natural weapon, such as claws or a bite, with which it is proficient. On a hit, it deals 1d4 kinetic damage.

{@b Attitude:} The beast obeys your commands as best it can. It acts on your turn, and you determine its actions, decisions, attitudes, and so on. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or absent, your beast acts on its own.

entries.name: Bestial Traits
entries: The traits are presented in alphabetical order. If a trait has prerequisites, your companion must meet them to adopt it. Your companion can adopt a trait at the same time that it meets the trait's prerequisites. Whenever your companion gains a level, it can exchange one trait for another one.

entries.name: Aerial
entries: Your companion has a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed, and {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} made against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Your companion has a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed, and it can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Burrower
entries: Your companion has a burrowing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed, and it has {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} out to 10 feet.

entries.name: Charger
entries: If your companion moves at least half its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} straight towards a target before making a melee attack, it deals an additional 1d8 damage on a hit.

entries.name: Climber
entries: Your companion has a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your companion is accustomed to low-light environments. Your companion can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. Your companion can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Evasive
entries: Your companion can take the {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Force Adept
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Force Sensitive} Your companion learns one 2nd-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} it can cast it at 2nd-level without expending force points. Your companion's {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).

entries.name: Force Contention
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: Your companion learns one at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and one 1st-level 11, which it can cast at its lowest level once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your companion's {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment). At-will powers chosen by your companion do not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if they would scale at 5th level, they instead scale at 11th level, and if they would scale at 11th level, they instead scale at 17th level.

entries.name: Grappler
entries: When your companion hits with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, it can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to grapple the target. On a success, the target is both {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} and {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained}, and your companion can't attack again while it has a creature grappled.

entries.name: Heavy Hide
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} becomes 14.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Light Hide
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} becomes 11 + its Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Medium Hide
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier, to a maximum of +2.

entries.name: Natural Camouflage
entries: When your companion attempts to hide, it can opt to not move on its turn. If it avoids moving, it is considered lightly obscured until it moves.

entries.name: Nimble Reflexes
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Nimble Weapon
entries: Your companion's natural weapon gains {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Pack Tactics
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a creature if at least one ally of your companion is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}.

entries.name: Pouncer
entries: If your companion moves at least half its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} straight toward a creature and hits it with a melee attack, the creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + its Strength modifier). If the creature is larger than your companion, it makes this save with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. On a failed save, the creature is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, and your companion can make one additional attack against it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your companion's carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Rampager
entries: If your companion reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a melee attack on its turn, your companion can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to move up to half its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and make a melee attack.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon
entries: Your companion has a natural ranged weapon, such as a spitter or tail spikes. It has a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 90 feet, and on a hit it deals kinetic damage equal to its natural weapon damage die.

entries.name: Reach Weapon
entries: Your companion has a natural weapon with reach, such as a tail or wings. It has the reach property, and on a hit it deals kinetic damage equal to its natural weapon damage die.

entries.name: Size: Huge
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} {@b Prerequisite: Size Large} Your companion's size is Huge. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d12}, its natural weapon damage die becomes a d12, and its walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to 40.

entries.name: Size: Large
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Size Medium} Your companion's size is Large. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d10}, its natural weapon damage die becomes a d10, and its walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to 35.

entries.name: Size: Medium
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Size Small} Your companion's size is Medium. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d8}, its natural weapon damage die becomes a d8, and its walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to 30.

entries.name: Size: Small
entries: Your companion's size is Small. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d6}, its natural weapon damage die becomes a d6, and its walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to 25.

entries.name: Sturdy-Legged
entries: Your companion's long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made against effects that would knock it prone.

entries.name: Swift
entries: Your companion can take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Tremorsense
entries: Your companion gains {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb|tremorsense} out to 30 feet.

entries.name: Venomous Weapon
entries: When your companion deals damage to a creature with its natural weapon, it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your companion's Constitution modifier) or become {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} until the end of its next turn.

variantrule.name: Droid Companion
entries: Your droid takes a form of your choosing. The class of droid you choose determines its features. Once you've selected your type of droid class, you assign your droid's ability scores using standard array (16, 14, 14, 12, 10, 8) as you see fit.

entries.name: Droid Features
entries: All droids share the following features.

items: {@b Droid Resistances:} Your droid is resistant to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage, and immune to poison and disease.

{@b Droid Vulnerabilities:} Your droid is vulnerable to ion damage. Additionally, your droid has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.
{@b Type:} Droid
{@b Armor Class:} Your droid's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

{@b Armor Integration:} Your droid can not wear armor, but it can have the armor professionally integrated into its chassis over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. This work must be done by someone proficient with {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. Your droid must be proficient in armor in order to have it integrated.
{@b Droid Systems:} Your droid does not need to eat or drink. Additionally, your droid does not require a tech focus to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
{@b Force Insensitive:} Your droid can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

{@b Maintenance Mode:} Rather than sleep, your droid must spend 3 hours performing routine maintenance during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, during which it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks. Additionally, if your droid's {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, it only needs to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it.

{@b Attitude:} The droid obeys your commands as best it can. It acts on your turn, and you determine its actions, decisions, attitudes, and so on. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or absent, your droid acts on its own.

entries.name: Class I Droid
entries: Class I droids, programmed for the mathematical, medical, or physical sciences, are subcategorized as medical droids, biological science droids, physical science droids, and mathematics droids.
As a class I droid, your droid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d8 per droid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 8 + your droid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d8 (or 5) + your droid's Constitution modifier per droid level after 1st

{@b Languages:} Your droid can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice. It can understand spoken and written {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}, but can not speak it.
{@b Skills:} One Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma skill of your choice
{@b Size:} Medium
{@b Speed:} 25 ft.

entries.name: Class II Droid
entries: Class II droids, programmed for the application of engineering and other technical sciences, are subcategorized as astromech droids, exploration droids, environmental droids, engineering droids, and maintenance droids.
As a class II droid, your droid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d6 per droid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 6 + your droid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d6 (or 4) + your droid's Constitution modifier per droid level after 1st
{@b Skills:} One of your choice
{@b Tools:} One {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb|specialist}'s kit of your choice

{@b Languages:} Your droid can speak, read, and write {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}. It can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice, but can not speak it.
{@b Size:} Small
{@b Speed:} 25 ft.

{@b Undersized:} Your droid's small stature makes it hard for it to wield bigger weapons. Your droid can't use heavy shields. Additionally, it can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, your droid can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Class III Droid
entries: Class III droids, programmed to interact with humans and said to be the most advanced droids ever invented, are subcategorized as protocol droids, servant droids, tutor droids, and child care droids.
As a class III droid, your droid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d8 per droid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 8 + your droid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d8 (or 5) + your droid's Constitution modifier per droid level after 1st
{@b Languages:} Your droid can speak and understand all registered languages
{@b Size:} Medium
{@b Speed:} 25 ft.

entries.name: Class IV Droid
entries: Class IV droids, programmed for military and security purposes, are subcategorized as assassin droids, battle droids, gladiator droids, and security droids.
As a class IV droid, your droid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d8 per droid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 8 + your droid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d8 (or 5) + your droid's Constitution modifier per droid level after 1st

{@b Languages:} Your droid can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice. It can understand spoken and written {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}, but can not speak it.
{@b Size:} Medium
{@b Speed:} 30 ft.

{@b Armored:} Your droid has proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}. If it would already have proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, it instead has proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. If it would already have proficiency in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, it instead has proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. If it would already have proficiency in all armor, it instead has proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice.

entries.name: Class V Droid
entries: Class V droids, programmed for menial and low-skill tasks, are subcategorized as construction droids, lifting droids, mining droids, sanitation droids, and transportation droids.
As a class V droid, your droid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d8 per droid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 8 + your droid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d8 (or 5) + your droid's Constitution modifier per droid level after 1st
{@b Skills:} {@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}
{@b Tools:} One set of artisan's implements

{@b Languages:} Your droid can speak, read, and write {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}. It can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice, but can not speak it.
{@b Size:} Medium
{@b Speed:} 30 ft.

entries.name: Droid Traits
entries: The traits are presented in alphabetical order. If a trait has prerequisites, your companion must meet them to adopt it. Your companion can adopt a trait at the same time that it meets the trait's prerequisites. Whenever your companion gains a level, it can exchange one trait for another one.

entries.name: Alarm Protocol
entries: You install an alarm module in your companion, granting it the following benefits:

items: Your companion gains a +5 bonus to {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}.
You and your companion can't be surprised while your companion is conscious.

entries.name: Analysis Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Class I Droid} Your companion can {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a target, develop a plan on how to best overcome any potential obstacle, and execute that plan with ruthless efficiency. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your companion's turn, your companion can analyze a target it can see within 60 feet of it. For the next minute, or until it analyzes another target, it gains the following benefits:

items: When it analyzes a hostile creature, its attack and damage rolls made with weapons with {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property} or {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons against that target may use its Intelligence modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.

When it analyzes a friendly creature, the target can end your companion's Analysis Protocol on them (no action required) to add half your companion's Intelligence modifier (rounded down, minimum of +1) to one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Once a friendly creature has benefited from this ability, they can not do so again until they complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Arm Cannons
entries: You install dual arm cannons in your companion. The arm cannons have 2 charges. As an action, your companion can use charges to cast the {@i overload} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, using 1 charge per level. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is made against your companion's tech save DC (8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your companion's Intelligence modifier).

You can choose this trait multiple times. Each time you do so, the arm cannons gain another charge, to a maximum of 4. The arm cannons regain all charges after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Back-Up Protocol
entries: You install an emergency protocol in your companion, prompting a quick {@spell Reboot|sw5e-phb|reboot} after critical damage is taken. If your companion would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it instead is reduced to 1.
Once your companion uses this feature, it must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before it can use it again.

entries.name: Celerity Augment
entries: You augment your companion to move a little faster. Your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet.

entries.name: Charisma Chip
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Class III Droid} You install a charisma chip in your companion. When an ally your companion can see makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, your companion can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to give them {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll. It can do so before or after they roll the {@dice d20}, but before the GM says the roll succeeds or fails. Once your companion uses this ability, it can't use it again until it finishes a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Darkvision Optics
entries: Your companion has {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If your companion already has darkvision, this trait increases its range by 30 feet.

entries.name: Durability Module
entries: You enhance your companion's durability, granting the following benefits:

items: When your companion rolls a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the minimum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} your companion can regain from the roll equals twice your companion's Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

Your companion's hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice its level when you install this protocol. Whenever your companion gains a level thereafter, its hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

entries.name: Emergency Mode
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Back-Up Protocol} You modify your companion's back-up protocol. When your companion's back-up protocol is initiated, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a target within range. If the target is the source of the damage that reduced your companion to 0, the attack roll has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Energy Shield
entries: You install an energy shield in your companion, which has 1 charge. As an action, your companion can use 1 charge to cast the {@i energy shield} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

You can choose this trait multiple times. Each time you do so, the energy shield gains another charge, to a maximum of 3. The energy shield regains all expended charges after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: False Combustion
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Class II Droid} As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} in response to taking damage, your companion can feign an explosion. For 1 minute, it appears to be destroyed to all outward inspection. A creature can use its action to inspect your companion and make an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check (DC = 8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your companion's Intelligence modifier). If it succeeds, it becomes aware that your companion still functions.

entries.name: Fighting Style Protocol
entries: Your companion adopts a particular style of fighting as its specialty. Choose one of the Fighting Style options, detailed in {@book chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6} of the Player's Handbook. Your companion can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if it later gets to choose again.

entries.name: Flamethrower
entries: You install a flamethrower in your companion. The flamethrower has 1 charge. As an action, your companion can cast the {@i jet of flame} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, though it does not scale with higher levels, or use 1 charge to cast the {@i flame sweep} 12 at 1st level. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is made against your companion's tech save DC (8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your companion's Intelligence modifier).

You can choose this trait multiple times. Each time you do so, the flamethrower gains another charge, to a maximum of 3. If the flamethrower has multiple charges, you can use multiple charges to cast flame sweep at a higher level, 1 point per charge. The flamethrower regains all expended charges after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Four-Armed Combatant
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Class IV Droid} You install two additional arms to improve your companion's combat capabilities, granting it four arms which it can use independently of one another. Your companion can only gain the benefit of items held by two of its arms at any given time, and once per round your companion can switch which arms it is benefiting from (no action required).
While your companion has at least 3 arms free, it has a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed.

entries.name: Heavy Plating
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Proficiency with {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}} Your companion gains proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. If your companion is already proficient in type=heavy armor, instead critical hits are treated as normal hits against it while type=heavy armor is integrated.

entries.name: Interface Protocol
entries: Your companion becomes a valid target for the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Light Plating
entries: Your companion gains proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}. If your companion is already proficient in type=light armor, instead your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 5 feet while type=light armor is integrated.

entries.name: Martial Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Class IV Droid} Your companion has martial training that allows it to perform special combat maneuvers. It gains the following benefits:

items: It learns two maneuvers of your choice from among those available to the fighter class. If a maneuver it uses requires its target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the maneuver's effects, the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC equals 8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your companion's Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

Your companion has two {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, which are d4s. These dice are used to fuel its maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when your companion uses it. It regain all of its expended {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} when it finishes a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Medium Plating
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Proficiency with {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}} Your companion gains proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}.  If your companion is already proficient in type=medium armor, the maximum Dexterity bonus your companion can add to AC increases to 3 from 2 while type=medium armor is integrated.

entries.name: Memory Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Class I Droid} Your companion can recall anything it has read in the past month that it understood. This includes but is not limited to books, maps, signs, and lists.

entries.name: Observant Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Alarm Protocol} You modify the alarm module in your companion, granting the following benefits:

items: If your companion can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language it understands, your companion can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips.

Your companion is considered to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} when determining its passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and passive Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) scores.

entries.name: Performance Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Class III Droid} You modify your companion's charisma chip, granting the following benefits:

items: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}) checks.

Your companion can also use its {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to motivate an ally within 30 feet of it. Until the start of your companion's next turn, the ally can add the droid's Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} they make. Your companion can use this feature a number of time equal to its Charisma modifier, and it regains all expended uses after it completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Powerful Droid
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Class V Droid} Your companion's carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Power Core
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1 and its Hit Die increases by one step (from {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, d8 to {@dice d10}, or d10 to {@dice d12}).
You can choose this trait multiple times.

entries.name: Powerful Grip
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Class V Droid} When your companion hits a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} on its turn and has a free hand, it can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to grapple the target. If it does so, and the grapple succeeds, your companion can make one additional attack against the target (no action required).

entries.name: Proficiency Protocol
entries: You install a protocol in your companion that grants it proficiency in a skill or tool. Your companion gains proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice.
You can choose this trait multiple times.

entries.name: Rapid Reconstructor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite} 5th level} Your companion can control and focus its healing. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, it can choose to spend one of its Hit Dice to recover {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

entries.name: Repulsor Coil
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Class II Droid} Your companion has a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed. While medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor} is integrated, its flying speed is reduced by half.

entries.name: Sensor Augmentation
entries: You augment your companion with an advanced sensor, granting the following benefits:

items: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors.
Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid or resist traps.
Your companion has resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
Your companion can search for traps while traveling at a normal pace, instead of only at a slow pace.

entries.name: Shard Modification
entries: You specially modify your companion to house a shard. Shards are sentient crystals native to the planet Orax, roughly a foot in length, that communicate with each other through pulses of light. While inhabiting a specialized droid host, shards are able to overcome the droid’s inability to wield the Force, granting the following benefits:

items: Your companion loses the Force Insensitive trait.

Your companion can cast the {@i sense force} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} once per day. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your companion's {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for this power.

entries.name: Stun Ray
entries: You install a stun ray in your companion. The stun ray has 1 charge. As an action, your companion can use 1 charge to cast the {@i hold droid} or {@i paralyze humanoid} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is made against your companion's tech save DC (8 + your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your companion's Intelligence modifier).

You can choose this trait multiple times. Each time you do so, the stun ray gains another charge, to a maximum of 3. The stun ray regains all expended charges after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Techcasting Protocol
entries: Your companion learns one at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and one 1st-level 12, which it can cast at its lowest level once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your companion's {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. At-will powers chosen by your companion do not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if they would scale at 5th level, they instead scale at 11th level, and if they would scale at 11th level, they instead scale at 17th level.

entries.name: Techcasting Protocol Mark II
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} Protocol} Your companion learns one 2nd-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of your choice, and once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} it can cast it at 2nd-level without expending tech points. Your companion's {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence.

entries.name: Toughness Module
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Durability Module} You modify the durability module in your companion, granting the following benefit:

items: Whenever your companion takes the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} action in combat, it can spend one Hit Die to heal itself. Roll the die, add its Constitution modifier, and it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the total (minimum of one).

entries.name: Truesight Optics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} {@b Prerequisite: {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb} Optics} Your companion can see through illusions and detect invisibility within 30 feet, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.

variantrule.name: Humanoid Companion
entries: Your humanoid takes a form and size of your choosing. Your humanoid's size determines its features. Once you've chosen the size of your humanoid, you assign your humanoid's ability scores using standard array (16, 14, 14, 12, 10, 8) as you see fit.

entries.name: Humanoid Features
entries: All humanoids share the following features.

items: {@b Languages:} Humanoids can speak, read, and write {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice. If your humanoid takes the form of a species that can't speak {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}, you choose whether or not your humanoid can speak it.
{@b Type:} Humanoid
{@b Armor Class:} Your humanoid's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier.

{@b Attitude:} The humanoid obeys your commands as best it can. It acts on your turn, and you determine its actions, decisions, attitudes, and so on. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or absent, your humanoid acts on its own.

entries.name: Tiny Humanoids
entries: Tiny humanoids are comprised of diminutive species such as anzellan or patitites.
As a tiny humanoid, your humanoid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d4 per humanoid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 4 + your humanoid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d4 (or 3) + your humanoid's Constitution modifier per humanoid level after 1st
{@b Tools:} One of your choice.
{@b Size:} Tiny
{@b Speed:} 20 ft.

{@b Pintsized:} Your humanoid's tiny stature makes it hard for it to wield bigger weapons. Your humanoid can't use medium or heavy shields. Additionally, it can't wield weapons with the two-handed or versatile property, and it can only wield one-handed weapons in two hands unless they have the light property.

{@b Puny:} Your humanoid is too small to pack much of a punch. It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, and when determining its bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength, it can't add more than +3.

{@b Small and Nimble:} Your humanoid is too small and fast to effectively target. It has a +1 bonus to AC, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Small Humanoids
entries: Small humanoids are comprised of shorter species such as ewoks or jawas.
As a small humanoid, your humanoid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d6 per humanoid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 6 + your humanoid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d6 (or 4) + your humanoid's Constitution modifier per humanoid level after 1st
{@b Skills:} One of your choice
{@b Tools:} One {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb|specialist}'s kit of your choice
{@b Size:} Small
{@b Speed:} 25 ft.

{@b Undersized:} Your humanoid's small stature makes it hard for it to wield bigger weapons. Your humanoid can't use heavy shields. Additionally, it can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, your humanoid can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Medium Humanoids
entries: Medium humanoids are the most common seen in the galaxy.
As a medium humanoid, your humanoid companion has the following features.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d8 per humanoid level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 8 + your humanoid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d8 (or 5) + your humanoid's Constitution modifier per humanoid level after 1st
{@b Size:} Medium
{@b Speed:} 30 ft.

{@b Armored:} Your humanoid has proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}. If it would already have proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}, it instead has proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. If it would already have proficiency in light and {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, it instead has proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. If it would already have proficiency in all armor, it instead has proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice.

entries.name: Humanoid Traits
entries: The traits are presented in alphabetical order. If a trait has prerequisites, your companion must meet them to adopt it. Your companion can adopt a trait at the same time that it meets the trait's prerequisites. Whenever your companion gains a level, it can exchange one trait for another one.

entries.name: Adaptive Resilience
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Aggressive
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, your companion can move up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} toward an enemy of its choice that it can see or hear. Your companion must end this move closer to the enemy than it started.

entries.name: Alert
entries: Always on the lookout for danger, your companion gains the following benefits:

items: Your companion gains a +5 bonus to {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}.
You and your companion can't be surprised while your companion is conscious.

entries.name: Athlete
entries: Your companion has undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:

items: When your companion is {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, standing up uses only 5 feet of its movement.
Climbing doesn't halve your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.
Your companion can make a running long jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: Your companion can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Cannibalize
entries: If your companion spends at least 1 minute devouring the corpse of a beast or humanoid, it gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to its Constitution modifier. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Closed Mind
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Your companion has a keen eyesight, especially in the dark. It can see in dim light within 60 feet of it as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. It can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Defensive Ball
entries: Your companion is able to curl into a rolling ball for extra protection. When it takes the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action while it isn't wielding a shield, it gains a bonus to AC equal to half its {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded up) until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Defiant
entries: When your companion or a creature it can see that can see and understand it makes an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, your companion can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to their roll (no action required). It can use this before or after the roll, but before the GM determines the roll's outcome. Once your companion has used this feature, it must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before it can use it again.

entries.name: Dungeon Delver
entries: Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, your companion gains the following benefits:

items: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors.
Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid or resist traps.
Your companion has resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
Your companion can search for traps while traveling at a normal pace, instead of only at a slow pace.

entries.name: Durable
entries: Hardy and resilient, your companion gains the following benefits:

items: When your companion rolls a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the minimum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} your companion can regain from the roll equals twice your companion's Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

Your companion's hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice its level when it chooses this trait. Whenever your companion gains a level thereafter, its hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

entries.name: Enthralling Pheromones
entries: Your companion can use its pheromones to influence individuals of both sexes. Whenever your companion rolls a 1 on a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}) check, it can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, once per short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, your companion can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma check as a 10. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries: Your companion adopts a particular style of fighting as its specialty. Choose one of the Fighting Style options, detailed in {@book chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6} of the Player's Handbook. Your companion can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if it later gets to choose again.

entries.name: Flight
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite} 9th level} Your companion has a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed. While wearing medium or {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, its flying speed is reduced by half.

entries.name: Force Adept
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Force Sensitive} Your companion knows one 2nd-level {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} it can cast it at 2nd-level without expending force points. Your companion's {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment).

entries.name: Force Contention
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force-Sensitive
entries: Your companion one at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and one 1st-level 11, which it can cast at its lowest level once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your companion's {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} is Wisdom or Charisma (depending on power alignment). At-will powers chosen by your companion do not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if they would scale at 5th level, they instead scale at 11th level, and if they would scale at 11th level, they instead scale at 17th level.

entries.name: Four-Armed
entries: Your companion has four arms which it can use independently of one another. It can only gain the benefit of items held by two of its arms at any given time, and once per round it can switch which arms it is benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite} 5th level} As an action on its turn, your companion can cower pathetically to distract nearby foes. Until the end of its next turn, your companion's allies gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against enemies within 10 feet of it that can see it.
Once your companion has used this trait, it can't use it again until it finishes a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hardy Cleverness
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Heavily Armored
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Proficiency with {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}} Your companion gains proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. If your companion is already proficient in type=heavy armor, instead critical hits are treated as normal hits against it.

entries.name: Hidden Step
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, your companion can turn {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, makes a damage roll, or forces someone to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
Once your companion has used this trait, it can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hide
entries: Your companion has a thick hide. When it isn't wearing armor, its AC is 13 + its Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Lightly Armored
entries: Your companion gains proficiency in {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}. If your companion is already proficient in type=light armor, instead your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 5 feet while type=light armor is integrated.

entries.name: Linguist
entries: Your companion has studied languages and codes, gaining the following benefits:

items: Your companion learns three languages of its choice.

Your companion can can ably create written ciphers. Others can't decipher a code it creates unless it teaches them, they succeed on an Intelligence check (DC = your Intelligence score + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}), or they use a power to decipher it.

entries.name: Mobile
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet.

entries.name: Moderately Armored
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Proficiency with {@filter light armor|items|type=light armor}} Your companion gains proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}.  If your companion is already proficient in type=medium armor, the maximum Dexterity bonus your companion can add to AC increases to 3 from 2 while type=medium armor is integrated.

entries.name: Naturally Stealthy
entries: Your companion can attempt to hide even when it is obscured only by a creature that is its size or larger than it.

entries.name: Nimble Agility
entries: Your companion reflexes and agility allow it to move with a burst of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. When your companion moves on its turn in combat, it can double its speed until the end of the turn. Once your companion has used this trait, it can't use it again until it moves 0 feet on one of its turns.

entries.name: Nimble Reflexes
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Nimbleness
entries: Your companion can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than it.

entries.name: Observant
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Alert} Quick to notice details of its environment, your companion gains the following benefits:

items: If your companion can see a creature's mouth while it is speaking a language it understands, your companion can interpret what it's saying by reading its lips.

Your companion is considered to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} when determining its passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and passive Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) scores.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: Your companion's carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.

entries.name: Proficient
entries: Your companion gains proficiency in one skill or tool of its choice.

entries.name: Rapid Regeneration
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite} 5th level} Your companion can control and focus its healing. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, it can choose to spend one of its Hit Dice to recover {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

entries.name: Regenerative
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite} 5th level} When your companion takes damage, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} as long as the damage would not reduce its hit points to 0.

entries.name: Second Heart
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite} 5th level} When your companion is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, it can drop to 1 hit point instead. It can't use this feature again until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Strong-Legged
entries: When your companion makes a long jump, it can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice its Strength score. When it makes a high jump, it can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice its Strength modifier.

entries.name: Tech Resistance
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Unarmed Combatant
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage. It can use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. It must use the same modifier for both rolls.

entries.name: Savage Attacks
entries: When your companion scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, it can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

entries.name: Savage Shorty
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Strength 13, size Small} Despite being short of stature, your companion's size has no impact on its strength and virility. Your companion gains the following benefits:

items: Your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 5 feet
Your companion loses the Undersized trait.

entries.name: Tech Adept
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@feat Tech Dabbler|sw5e-phb}} Your companion learns one 2nd-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of your choice, and once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} it can cast it at 2nd-level without expending tech points. Your companion's {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. Your companion requires use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for this power.

entries.name: Tech Dabbler
entries: Your companion learns one at-will {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and one 1st-level 12, which it can cast at its lowest level once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Your companion's {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} is Intelligence. Your companion requires use of a {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} for these powers. At-will powers chosen by your companion do not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if they would scale at 5th level, they instead scale at 11th level, and if they would scale at 11th level, they instead scale at 17th level.

entries.name: Tiny Terror
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Strength 13, size Tiny} Despite falling below knee height of other species, your companion's size has less impact on its strength and virility. Your companion gains the following benefits:

items: Your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 5 feet
Your companion loses the Pintsized trait, and it is no longer limited to +3 when determining its bonus to attack and damage rolls for weapon attacks using Strength due to the Puny trait.

Your companion gains the Undersized trait: {@b {@i Undersized.}} Your companion's small stature makes it hard for it to wield bigger weapons. It can't use heavy shields or {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, your companion can only wield it in two hands.

entries.name: Tough
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} {@feat Durable|sw5e-phb}} Your companion has the blood of heroes flowing through its veins. Your companion gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever your companion takes the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} action in combat, it can spend one Hit Die to heal itself. Roll the die, add its Constitution modifier, and it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the total (minimum of one).

entries.name: Trance
entries: Your companion only needs 3 hours of sleep during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, instead of 6. Additionally, if your companion's long rest would be interrupted, it only needs to complete the long rest instead of restarting it to gain its benefits.

entries.name: Weapon Expert
entries: Your companion gains proficiency with {@filter all blasters|items|firearm=true}, {@filter lightweapons|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, and {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon}. If your companion is already proficient with firearm=true, type=martial weapon or type=martial weapon, instead once per turn when it rolls damage for a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} using a weapon from a category in which it is proficient with all weapons, it can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.

variantrule.name: Tracker Droid Companion
entries: Your tracker droid takes a form of your choosing. Once you've selected your tracker droid's appearance, you assign your tracker droid's ability scores using a standard array (16, 14, 12, 10, 8, 6) as you see fit.

entries.name: Tracker Droid Features
entries: All tracker droids share the following traits.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d4 per tracker droid companion level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 4 + your tracker droid's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d4 (or 3) + your tracker droid's Constitution modifier per tracker droid level after 1st
{@b Droid Resistances:} Your tracker droid is resistant to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage, and immune to poison and disease.

{@b Droid Vulnerabilities:} Your tracker droid is vulnerable to ion damage. Additionally, your tracker droid has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.
{@b Skills:} Two of your choice
{@b Tools:} One of your choice, which comes integrated into the droid

{@b Languages:} Tracker droids can speak, read, and write {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary}. They can understand spoken and written {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} and one language of your choice, but can not speak it.
{@b Size:} Tiny
{@b Speed:} 20 feet
{@b Type:} Droid
{@b Armor Class:} Your tracker droid's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier. Your tracker droid can't wear armor or have it integrated.

{@b Droid Systems:} Your tracker droid does not need to eat or drink. Additionally, your tracker droid does not require a tech focus to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, and it is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

{@b Droid Weaponry:} Your tracker droid has an integrated shockprod with which it can make weapon attacks. This weapon can't be removed while your tracker droid is conscious. Your tracker droid's shockprod deals 1 lightning damage on a hit, and it has {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.
{@b Force Insensitive:} Your tracker droid can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

{@b Maintenance Mode:} Rather than sleep, your companion must spend 3 hours performing routine maintenance during a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} to gain its benefits, during which it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks. Additionally, if your companion's {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} would be interrupted, it only needs to complete the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} instead of restarting it.

{@b Attitude:} The tracker droid obeys your commands as best it can. It acts on your turn, and you determine its actions, decisions, attitudes, and so on. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or absent, your tracker droid acts on its own.

entries.name: Tracker Droid Traits
entries: The traits are presented in alphabetical order. If a trait has prerequisites, your companion must meet them to adopt it. Your companion can adopt a trait at the same time that it meets the trait's prerequisites. Whenever your companion gains a level, it can exchange one trait for another one.

entries.name: Aerial Travel Package
entries: Your companion has a 30 foot flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} made against it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Camouflage Module
entries: You install a camouflage module in your companion. Your companion can activate its camouflage module to become {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible}. While it is invisible, anything it is carrying or wearing is also invisible. It becomes visible if it attacks, casts a power, takes a hostile action, or when it deactivates the module. Activating or deactivating the module requires an action.

Deduct the time your companion is invisible, in increments of 1 minute, from the module's maximum duration of 2 hours. After 2 hours of use, the module ceases to function. For every uninterrupted period of 12 hours the module goes unused, it regains 1 hour of use.

entries.name: Darkvision Optics
entries: Your companion has {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If your companion already has darkvision, this trait increases its range by 30 feet.

entries.name: Four-Armed Tracker
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Pintsized Arms} or {@i Undersized Arms} Your companion gains two additional arms which they can use independently of one another. Your companion can only gain the benefit of items held by two of its arms at any given time, and once per round it can switch which arms it is benefiting from (no action required).

entries.name: Heavy Plating
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} becomes 14.

entries.name: Interfaced Assistance Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While you are interfaced with your companion via the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, whenever you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} granted by your companion taking the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action, you can reroll one of the dice once.

entries.name: Interfaced Crafting Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While you are interfaced with your companion via the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using artisan's implements with which you are proficient, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check. If you already have advantage, you can instead reroll one of the dice once.

entries.name: Interfaced Distraction Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While you are interfaced with your companion via the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when your companion is within 5 feet of a target, you do not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} when moving out of that creature's reach.

entries.name: Interfaced Healing Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While you are interfaced with your companion via the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature that is within 5 feet of your companion, you can roll the dice twice and take either total.

entries.name: Interfaced Tracking Protocol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While you are interfaced with your companion via the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when you make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) check to track a target, and your companion is also tracking that target, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the check. If you already have advantage, you can instead reroll one of the dice once.

entries.name: Keen Hearing
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on hearing.

entries.name: Keen Sight
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Keen Smell
entries: Your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell.

entries.name: Laser Cutter
entries: Your companion can cut through 1-inch-thick glass at a rate of 3 inches per round.

entries.name: Light Plating
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} becomes 11 + its Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Medium Plating
entries: Your companion's {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier, to a maximum of +2.

entries.name: Pintsized Arms
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Size Tiny} Your Tiny tracker droid gains two arms that struggle to wield bigger weapons. Your companion can't use medium or heavy shields. Additionally, your companion can't wield weapons with the two-handed or versatile property, and it can only wield one-handed weapons in two hands unless they have the light property.

entries.name: Proficiency Protocol
entries: You install a protocol in your companion that grants it proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice.

entries.name: Ranged Interface Protocol
entries: The range within which you can interact with your companion increases by 50 feet. This increases by an additional 50 feet at 5th level (100), 9th level (150), 13th level (200), 17th level (250), and 20th level (300).

entries.name: Ranged Shockshot
entries: Your companion gains a ranged shockshot. It has a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 90 feet, and on a hit it deal lightning damage equal to its shockprod damage.

entries.name: Scomp Link
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} Your companion gets an integrated scomp link which it can use to interface with computers. While interfaced, when you or your companion makes an Intelligence ({@item Slicer's kit|sw5e-phb|slicer's kit}) check, you can choose to reroll the check. You must use the new roll. You can wait until after you roll the {@dice d20} before deciding to use this feature, but you must decide before the GM says whether the check succeeds or fails.

entries.name: Sentry Dish
entries: Your companion learns the {@i alarm} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. It can cast it once, without spending tech points, and it regains the ability to do so when it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Intelligence is its {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for this power.

entries.name: Size: Small
entries: Your companion's size is Small. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d6}, its shockprod damage die becomes a {@dice d4}, and it's walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to 25.

entries.name: Spider Legs
entries: Your companion has a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed. Additionally, your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Storage
entries: Your companion comes with a hidden storage compartment which can store up to 1 lb. Finding this hidden compartment requires a DC 15 {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} check.

entries.name: Techcasting Range Protocol
entries: You can cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of 5 feet or greater through your companion while interfaced with it, but your companion must be within 5 feet of the target of the power. This increases to 10 feet at 5th level, 20 feet at 9th level, 30 feet at 13th level, 60 feet at 17th level, and 120 feet at 20th level.

entries.name: Truesight Optics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} {@b Prerequisite: {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb} Optics} Your companion can see through illusions and detect invisibility within 60 feet, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.

entries.name: Undersized Arms
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Size Small} Your Small tracker droid gains two arms that struggle to wield bigger weapons. Your companion can't use heavy shields. Additionally, your companion can't use {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} with the two-handed property unless it also has the light property, and if a martial weapon has the versatile property, your companion can only wield it in two hands.

variantrule.name: Turret Companion
entries: Your turret is a portable companion that you can upgrade over time. Your turret uses your Intelligence score, and its Charisma is 6. You assign your turret's Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom scores using a standard array (16, 14, 12, 8) as you see fit.

entries.name: Turret Features
entries: All turrets share the following traits.

items: {@b Hit Dice:} 1d6 per turret companion level
{@b Hit Points at 1st Level:} 6 + your turret's Constitution modifier
{@b Hit Points at Higher Levels:} 1d6 (or 4) + your turret's Constitution modifier per turret level after 1st
{@b Turret Resistances:} Your turret is resistant to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage, and immune to poison and disease.

{@b Turret Vulnerabilities:} Your turret is vulnerable to ion damage. Additionally, your turret has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against effects that would deal ion or lightning damage.
{@b Languages:} Your turret does not understand any languages, and it cannot speak.
{@b Size:} Small

{@b Speed:} Your turret has two modes: undeployed and deployed. While undeployed, your turret's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equals your own and it can take no actions. While deployed, your turret has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 25 feet and can take actions. You can deploy or undeploy your turret at any time on your turn (no action required), but the effect doesn't occur until the start of your next turn.
{@b Type:} Construct
{@b Armor Class:} Your turret uses its Intelligence score for its {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb}.
{@b Force Insensitive:} Your turret can not use {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or take levels in {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} classes.

{@b Integrated Weaponry:} Your turret has an integrated {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which it is proficient and can make weapon attacks. Neither weapon can be removed while your turret is not disabled. Your turret's {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} deals 1d8 kinetic damage on a hit. Your turret's {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} has the ammunition (range 100/400) and reload 20 properties, and it deals 1d6 kinetic or energy damage on it a hit, depending on its loaded ammunition. It can use both slug cartridges and {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells} for ammunition. Your turret can't reload itself. You can choose which weapon your turret uses each time it attacks (no action required).
{@b Turret Systems:} Your turret does not need to eat or drink. Additionally, your turret does not require a tech focus to cast {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

{@b Attitude:} Your turret has a remote control, which you can use to direct it while within 120 feet of it (no action required). If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or absent, your turret takes no actions unless a trait says otherwise.

entries.name: Turret Traits
entries: The traits are presented in alphabetical order. If a trait has prerequisites, your companion must meet them to adopt it. Your companion can adopt a trait at the same time that it meets the trait's prerequisites. Whenever your companion gains a level, it can exchange one trait for another one.

entries.name: Augmenting Barrier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} As an action, you can reduce your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and have it create a barrier that surrounds in a radius depending on its size. A Small turret's speed is reduced to 10 feet and has a 5-foot radius, a Medium turret's speed is reduced to 5 feet and has a 10-foot radius, and a Large turret's speed is to reduce to 0 and has a 15-foot radius. While active, when damage is dealt by a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} originating from inside the barrier against a target outside the barrier, that 12 gains a bonus to damage equal to half your Intelligence modifier (rounded up).

This barrier lasts for 1 minute. You can end it early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Autoreload
entries: You can preload your companion's {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with additional ammunition. You can preload two additional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, or you can replace each Power cell with 20 slug cartridges. Once on each of your turns, you can reload your companion without using an action. Once you've expended the preloaded ammunition, you can't reload your companion's firearm=true in this way again until you reload it with an action.

entries.name: Climbing Turret
entries: Your companion has a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to its walking speed, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Cloaking Barrier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} As an action, you can reduce your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and have it create a barrier that surrounds in a radius depending on its size. A Small turret's speed is reduced to 10 feet and has a 5-foot radius, a Medium turret's speed is reduced to 5 feet and has a 10-foot radius, and a Large turret's speed is to reduce to 0 and has a 15-foot radius. While active, this barrier creates an area that is lightly obscured. Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that originate outside the barrier take a -10 penalty when attempting to detect anything inside the barrier.

This barrier lasts for 1 minute. You can end it early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Deployment Accelerator
entries: Your companion now deploys and undeploys instantly, but you can only do so once on each of your turns.

entries.name: Disguised Turret
entries: Your companion can collapse into an innocuous looking container while undeployed. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) checks to hide the nature of your companion while it is undeployed.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries: Your companion adopts a particular style of fighting as its specialty. Choose one of the Fighting Style options, detailed in {@book chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6} of the Player's Handbook. Your companion can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if it later gets to choose again.

entries.name: Hovering Turret
entries: Your companion can hover 5 feet over the ground while deployed. It ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} while hovering in this way.

entries.name: Integrated Grenade Launcher
entries: You integrate a grenade launcher into your companion.
You can choose this upgrade multiple times. Each time you do so, the weapon's reload number increases by 1.

entries.name: Integrated Projector
entries: You integrate a vapor projector into your companion.
You can choose this upgrade multiple times. Each time you do so, the weapon's reload number increases by 1.

entries.name: Integrated Rocket Launcher
entries: You integrate a rocket launcher into your companion.
You can choose this upgrade multiple times. Each time you do so, the weapon's reload number increases by 1.

entries.name: Modifiable Weaponry
entries: You can replace your companion's integrated {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} or {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with a different weapon of the same type. The new weapon cannot be removed while your companion is not disabled.
You can choose this upgrade twice.

entries.name: Phalanx Barrier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} As an action, you can reduce your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and have it create a barrier that surrounds in a radius depending on its size. A Small turret's speed is reduced to 10 feet and has a 5-foot radius, a Medium turret's speed is reduced to 5 feet and has a 10-foot radius, and a Large turret's speed is to reduce to 0 and has a 15-foot radius. While active, ranged weapon attacks originating from outside the barrier that pass through it have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. Ranged weapon attacks originating from inside the barrier are unaffected.

This barrier lasts for 1 minute. You can end it early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Ram Attachment
entries: You integrate a battering ram into your companion. When your companion makes a Strength check to break down physical doors, it gains a bonus to the check, depending on its size. A Small turret gains a +2 bonus, a Medium turret gains a +3 bonus, and a Large turret gains a +5 bonus.

entries.name: Rejuvenating Barrier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} As an action, you can reduce your companion's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and have it create a barrier that surrounds in a radius depending on its size. A Small turret's speed is reduced to 10 feet and has a 5-foot radius, a Medium turret's speed is reduced to 5 feet and has a 10-foot radius, and a Large turret's speed is to reduce to 0 and has a 15-foot radius.
