While active, friendly creatures that enter this barrier for the first time or start their turn there regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Intelligence modifier, and gain temporary hit points equal to your Intelligence modifier. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum.

This barrier lasts for 1 minute. You can end it early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your turn. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Sentry
entries: You add an overwatch suite to your companion. When you cast the {@i alarm} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can choose to have your companion notified when the alarm is triggered. If you do so, when the alarm is triggered, your companion immediately makes a number of weapon attacks against the triggering creature up to your companion's {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If multiple creatures trigger the alarm simultaneously, your companion targets each creature randomly.

entries.name: Size: Large
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Size: Medium} Your companion's size is Large. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d10}, its {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} damages increase to 1d12 and 1d10, respectively, and its deployed walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} decreases to 15 feet.

entries.name: Size: Medium
entries: Your companion's size is Medium. Its {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to its level + 1, its Hit Die becomes a {@dice d8}, its {@filter vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon} and {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} damages increase to 1d10 and 1d8, respectively, and its deployed walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} decreases to 20 feet.

entries.name: Suppressing Fire
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} When a creature within 30 feet of you moves at least 5 feet, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have your companion make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with its {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} against the creature. If the attack hits, the creature's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduce by half until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Turret Coverage
entries: As an action, you can have your companion anchor itself to the ground or recover itself. While anchored, its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduce to 0, it has resistance to energy and kinetic damage, and it provides {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} to creatures within 5 feet of it, depending on its size. A Small turret provides one-quarter cover, a Medium turret provides half cover, and a Large turret provides three-quarters cover. If an attack would miss a creature by an amount less than or equal to the bonus to AC granted by your companion's cover, and the attack would hit your companion, your companion instead takes the attack's damage.

variantrule.name: Follower
entries: As a follower, your companion gains the following features.

entries.name: Companion Traits
entries: Beginning at 1st level, your companion gains two traits, determined by its nature. Companion natures are discussed later in this chapter. Your companion gains an additional trait at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

entries.name: Helpful
entries: At 2nd level, your companion can take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, but it can only help you in this way.

entries.name: Companion Class
entries: When your companion reaches 3rd level, it can choose a class that determines how it focuses its training, which is detailed at the end of the follower's description. Your companion's class grants features at 3rd level, and again at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 18th level.

entries.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When your companion reaches 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, it can increase one ability score of its choice by 2, or it can increase two ability scores of its choice by 1. As normal, you can’t increase an ability score above 20 using this feature

entries.name: Expertise
entries: At 6th level, choose one of your companion's skill or tool proficiencies. It gains {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the chosen skill or tool.
At 14th level, your companion gains expertise in another skill or tool.

entries.name: Companion Freedom
entries: Once your companion has reached 10th level, your companion no longer requires you to use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to allow it to take an action other than Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Guard or Hide.

entries.name: Feat
entries: Also at 10th level, your companion gains one feat of your choice. Your companion can't take a feat that would grant them a companion.
By 20th level, your companion has reached the peak of its capabilities. Two ability scores of its choice increase by 2. Its maximum for those scores increases by 2.

variantrule.name: Companion Classes
entries: Your companion's class grants it features at 3rd level, and again at 7th, 11th, 15th, and 18th level.
You may choose your companion's class from the following options or roll on the table below to determine it randomly.
If you determine your companion's class randomly, and the result is a class for which the companion is ineligible, simply reroll until you get a proper result.
